result.markdown:
Yes. I searched specifically for **Perth lawyers with TPD (Total and Permanent Disability), superannuation and insurance-claim expertise**, rather than general personal-injury firms.

### My Perth shortlist

| **Firths The Compensation Lawyers** | Very strong TPD/superannuation focus; specifically handles TPD, super, income protection, trauma and rejected TPD claims. Their Perth office is at 108 St Georges Terrace. [www.firths.com.au](https://www.firths.com.au/offices/40/perth?utm_source=chatgpt.com) | **Established specialist / rejected claims** |
| **LHD Lawyers Perth** | Large personal-injury practice with a dedicated TPD/super team. They advertise 35+ years' experience and $220m+ compensation settled overall. [www.lhd.com.au](https://www.lhd.com.au/office-location/wa/perth/tpd-superannuation-claims/?utm_source=chatgpt.com) | **People wanting a larger established firm** |
| **Aussie Injury Lawyers Perth** | Dedicated Perth TPD lawyers, no-win-no-fee model and experience with insurance litigation. Their Perth office is at 197 St Georges Terrace. [aussieinjurylawyers.com.au](https://aussieinjurylawyers.com.au/legal-offices/superannuation-tpd-claims-perth/?utm_source=chatgpt.com) | **No-win-no-fee TPD claims** |
| **Withstand Lawyers** | Specialist TPD practice with a Perth service, 4.9/5 from 265+ Google reviews according to its site, and lawyers who work specifically in TPD/superannuation. [www.withstandlawyers.com.au](https://www.withstandlawyers.com.au/wa/tpd-lawyers-perth/?utm_source=chatgpt.com) | **Personalised service / TPD specialist** |


### If it were my claim

I'd get **2–3 free assessments before signing anything**, probably starting with:

1. **WKB** — because the practice is unusually specialised in TPD/superannuation.
2. **Firths** — particularly if the insurer has already rejected or complicated the claim.
3. **LHD or Withstand** — as a comparison on fees, strategy and who would actually run the matter.

One important point: **don't choose solely on a firm's advertised "success rate."** Those figures are self-reported and may not be calculated on the same basis. The more useful questions are *how many claims like yours the particular lawyer handles, whether they've dealt with your super fund/insurer, what happens if the claim is rejected, and exactly how the no-win-no-fee costs work.*

The WA Government's Insurance Commission also recommends asking about the cost of the initial consultation and legal fees before engaging a lawyer. [www.icwa.wa.gov.au](https://www.icwa.wa.gov.au/motor-injury-insurance/make-an-injury-claim/compensation/do-i-need-a-lawyer?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

If you tell me **which super fund/insurer you have, whether your TPD claim has been rejected yet, and whether it's physical injury, illness or mental-health related**, I can narrow this to the **2–3 Perth lawyers I'd approach first** and compare their fees, reviews and relevant case experience.
